title: 第29章 四重进化
novel_title: 御兽仙朝：我能设计进化形态
content_zh:
罗影在院子当中，立了很久。

    久到罗川那一墙泥都抹齐了，久到爹磕了磕烟袋，扶着腰回了屋，久到天边最后一点光，沉进了西山。

    他没动。

    脑子里那根弦，刚刚接上。他怕一动，就散了。

    那把钥匙，他找到了。

    钥匙是什么样，他已经看清了。

    可这把钥匙，怎么递到小玄手里，他还没想好。

    夜里，等家里人都睡熟了，罗影没有点灯。

    他摸黑下了床，摸到了墙角那只破陶盆，在盆边，盘腿坐了下来。

    小玄从他手背爬下来，落在盆沿上。盆里的沙，被它这一个月，踩出了一道道细痕。

    墙缝跟前，那一堆它码了一个月的料，在夜色里，黑黢黢的，堆着。

    罗影没有去碰那些料子。

    他张了张嘴巴，又闭上了。

    他心里头那些话堵着、烫着，可一个字也吐不出来。

    为什么你不把窝搭完呢？

    他清楚为什么。

    但是把这句话，直接说出口，就跟拿手去揭一块结了痂的疮一样。

    揭开之后，底下还是血肉模糊，很疼，但是好不了。

    道理，戳是戳不进去的。

    他突然想到，在山道上时，自己也是这样，对着小玄开不了口。

    那一回，他并没有讲道理。

    讲述的是狼王的故事。

    门，是从故事那道缝里挤进去的。

    罗影闭上眼睛，之后又睁开了。

    今夜，也这么来吧。

    他依据窗外射入的灯光，压低声音慢慢开口，好像在对黑暗说话：

    “我来跟你说件事吧。”

    小玄的触须微微动了一下。

    “早年，常听村里的老人念叨，说邻村，有这么一条狗。”

    “那是一条看家的老狗。”

    “它看守着一个院子。那院子的主人一家子早年间出远门去了。”

    “出了门，就没再回来过。”

    小玄趴伏在盆沿上，并没什么反应。

    这个开头看去，似乎只是一个普通的故事。

    罗影看着墙角的料子，语气非常平淡地说：

    “只剩下一条老狗看守着空院子。”

    “日子久了之后，那院门就坏了，裂缝很大。”

    “下雨天的时候，风吹进来，雨水也跟着进来了，院子里到处都是水。”

    “村里有人不忍心看着。想给院子的门修理一下、补一补钉牢点，使它有一个可以遮风挡雨的窝。”

    小玄的动作变的很慢。

    它的触须朝着罗影的方向偏了点。

    “可怪就怪在这儿。”

    罗影的声音有点低沉。

    “谁去补那道门，那老狗就跟谁急。”

    “它露出尖利的牙齿，护着那道豁口，如果有谁伸出手来，它就会咬谁。”

    “第一次遇到这种情况，人们把它看作是怕生。”

    “第二次的时候，人们觉得自身的动作太重了，惊吓到它了。”

    “来来往往好几拨人要修，可却没有一个能把那扇门补好。”

    “最后，全村人都说，这条狗，是守那座空院子，守魔怔了。守傻了。”

    盆沿处，小玄已经完全不动了。

    甲壳上的一圈又一圈的环纹，微弱地发亮。

    一亮一灭。

    它在听。

    它听得入了神。

    罗影停顿了一下。

    “后来啊，因为一场大雪，把这件事闹明白了。”

    “那个冬天，冷的邪乎。”

    “有个人，实在看那狗可怜，半夜趁它睡熟了，悄悄把那道豁了多年的院门，给钉上了。”

    “木板钉得严严实实。院子，头一回，密不透风。”

    “那人想着，这下，狗总能睡个暖和觉了。”

    小玄的触须，悬在了半空，一动不动。

    罗影的声音，轻了下去。

    “那老狗，半夜醒了。”

    “它看见那道补严实了的门，对着它，叫了整整一夜。”

    “不是凶。是哭。”

    “那哭声，半个村子都听见了。”

    “天亮，人过去看。”

    “那老狗，趴在门底下，已经冻硬了。”

    “它的鼻子，死死拱在门板的缝上。它的头，朝着院门外头。”

    “朝着，它主人当年出门、再没回来的，那条路。”

    盆沿上，那只小小的蚁，浑身都在抖。

    它把六足收得死紧，把身子缩成一团，像是想把自己，从这世上整个藏起来。

    就跟当日芦花的喙凑到它跟前时，一模一样。

    可它藏不住。

    盆沿就这么大，沙就这么浅。

    没有土能让它钻，没有草能让它躲。

    罗影没有再讲下去。

    那条冻死在门底下、朝着来路的老狗，他讲完了。

    他停了很久，久到夜风都静了。

    然后，他从怀里，摸出了几样东西，一点一点，摊在了掌心。

    头一样，是一小撮牛鬃。
content_en:
Luo Ying stood in the courtyard for a long time.
It took a long time until all the mud on the wall in Luochuan was plastered. It took a long time until my father smoked his pipe and returned to the house, holding on to his waist. It took a long time until the last light on the horizon sank into the Western Mountain.
He didn't move.
The string in my mind has just been connected.He was afraid that if he moved, he would disperse.
He found the key.
He had already seen clearly what the key looked like.
But how to hand this key into Xiao Xuan's hand, he hasn't figured out yet.
At night, when everyone in the family was asleep, Luo Ying did not light the lamp.
He got out of bed in the dark, touched the broken pottery basin in the corner, and sat down cross-legged beside the basin.
Xiao Xuan climbed down from the back of his hand and landed on the edge of the basin.The sand in the basin has been trampled by it for a month, leaving fine marks.
In front of the crack in the wall, there was a pile of materials that he had stacked for a month, piled up dark in the night.
Luo Ying didn't touch those materials.
He opened his mouth and closed it again.
The words in his heart were stuck and burning, but he couldn't utter a single word.
Why don't you finish building the nest?
He knew why.
But saying these words directly is like picking up a scabbed sore with your hands.
After uncovering it, it was still bloody and bloody underneath, and it hurt, but it wasn't getting better.
The truth is, you can't poke it in.
He suddenly thought that he was like this when he was on the mountain road, unable to speak to Xiao Xuan.
That time, he wasn't being reasonable.
It tells the story of the Wolf King.
The door is squeezed in through the crack in the story.
Luo Ying closed his eyes and then opened them again.
Let's do the same tonight.
He lowered his voice and spoke slowly according to the light coming from the window, as if speaking to the darkness:
"Let me tell you something."
Xiao Xuan's tentacles moved slightly.
"In my early years, I often heard old people in the village talking about a dog like this in a neighboring village."
"That's an old guard dog."
"It guards a yard. The owner of that yard went on a long trip in the early years."
"I walked out the door and never came back."
Xiao Xuan lay on the edge of the basin and didn't react at all.
At first glance, this seems to be just an ordinary story.
Luo Ying looked at the materials in the corner and said in a very calm tone:
“Only an old dog is left guarding the empty yard.”
"After a long time, the courtyard door became damaged and there were big cracks."
"When it rains, the wind blows in, the rain comes in, and there's water everywhere in the yard."
"Some people in the village couldn't bear to watch. They wanted to repair the door of the yard and patch it up so that it could have a shelter from wind and rain."
Xiaoxuan's movements became very slow.
Its tentacles tilted towards Luo Ying's direction.
"That's where the blame lies."
Luo Ying's voice was a little low.
"Whoever repairs that door will be in trouble with the old dog."
"It showed its sharp teeth and guarded the gap. If anyone stretched out his hand, it would bite him."
"When this happens for the first time, people see it as fear."
"The second time, people felt that their movements were too heavy and frightened it."
"Several groups of people came and went to repair the door, but no one could fix the door."
"In the end, the whole village said that this dog was Shou Mo in that empty yard. Shou Mo was stunned. Shou was stupid."
At the edge of the basin, Xiao Xuan was completely motionless.
The rings on the carapace glowed faintly.
On and off.
It's listening.
It listened with rapt attention.
Luo Ying paused.
"Later, because of a heavy snowfall, the matter came to light."
"That winter was extremely cold."
"There was a man who really felt sorry for the dog. In the middle of the night, while it was asleep, he secretly nailed the courtyard door that had been open for many years."
"The wooden boards are nailed tightly. The yard, for the first time, is airtight."
"The man thought, now, the dog can finally sleep warm."
Xiao Xuan's tentacles were hanging in the air, motionless.
Luo Ying's voice became softer.
"That old dog woke up in the middle of the night."
"It saw the patched door and barked at it all night long."
"It's not fierce. It's crying."
"Half the village heard the cry."
"At dawn, people come and take a look."
"The old dog is lying under the door, frozen solid."
"Its nose is firmly pressed against the seam of the door panel. Its head is facing outside the courtyard gate."
"Toward the road where its owner went out and never came back."
On the edge of the basin, the little ant was shaking all over.
It tightened its six legs and huddled its body into a ball, as if it wanted to hide itself completely from the world.
It was exactly the same as when the reed flower's beak came up to it.
But it can't be hidden.
The rim of the basin is only this big, and the sand is only this shallow.
There is no soil for it to burrow into, no grass for it to hide in.
Luo Ying did not continue talking.
He finished talking about the old dog that froze to death under the door, facing the way he came.
He paused for a long time, so long that the night wind became still.
Then, he took out several things from his arms and spread them out in his palms bit by bit.
The head is the same, with a small tuft of ox mane.
